summary: Validated L1 execution benchmark reconciled to revision 5: a causal queue-aware maker/taker gate reduced five-second execution drag by 0.200 bp in development, 0.199 bp in validation and 0.149 bp in confirmation, but standalone net expectancy remained about -11.8 bp. Retain as the execution-routing component leader for prospective Shadow only; the strategy Champion is unchanged.

Hard-valid official Binance USD-M four-asset dynamic-factor residual study. Candidate 021fbab613517a31ad98 produced 194 one-global-slot trades and actual-funding returns +23.2585%/+16.7170%/+11.2649% at 12/18/24bp, geometric daily growth +0.0573077%, PF 1.5041 and MDD 4.6174%. It is provisional rank 1 by target proximity but fails the registered economic gate: top-10%-removed return -21.8583%, median trade negative and all four frozen 2024 portfolios lost.

Hard-valid BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT/XRPUSDT one-global-slot study with historical funding. The 216-policy five-minute screen and 324-policy prior-volume dollar-clock follow-up produced zero preregistered development survivors and opened no sequential OOS. Exploratory aligned-continuation 33034b092ffd271a recorded 0.0227977% geometric daily growth near 15bp and 0.0118956% near 30bp, 184/183 trades, PF 1.306/1.160 and MDD 6.47%/7.84%, but failed yearly robustness and the 2x top-five-removal gate. It is provisional rank 2 only.

Recovered the immutable ten-day BTC cross-venue liquidation/depth artifact and re-evaluated 7,760 original continuation, reclaim and venue-transfer policies plus 680 low-dimensional mechanism policies under chronological confirmation, next-observed bid/ask execution, one global slot, 8-24 bp costs and top-trade-removal gates. Zero strict or exploratory survivors were found. The tested historical specification is retained as valid negative evidence and does not change the strategy first place or live permission.

Implemented an observation-only Binance/Bybit public and Bybit private forward evidence layer with local wall and monotonic receive clocks, raw-payload hashes, append-only record chains, environment-only authentication, execId-authoritative reconciliation, exact-capture-prefix Shadow A/B and automatic risk-state mapping. The readable source passed 22 local tests, per-file manifest verification and compileall. No prospective observations exist yet; no alpha, Paper/Live promotion or order-placement capability is claimed.

Official Deribit completed-hour BTC/ETH DVOL common, relative and implied-versus-realized states routed four-asset Binance USD-M factor-neutral residual continuation/reversion across 960 preregistered candidates. Zero passed the 2022 development gate, so 2023 remained unopened. Best raw 12bp candidate had 76 trades, +0.9291% total return, 0.003400% geometric daily growth, PF 1.068, MDD 3.45%, negative median trade and -7.37% after removing the largest 10% positive trades; it lost at 18/24bp. Best candidate with at least 100 trades had 232 trades, +0.7606% at 12bp, -4.9605% at 18bp, -9.7742% at 24bp, negative median trade and -31.15% after top-10% removal. Current first place unchanged.

Hard-valid official Binance BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT spot-versus-USD-M one-minute price-discovery study. All 496 preregistered policies failed the 2022 development gate, so 2023 and later remained unopened. The best perpetual-overshoot-reversal candidate produced 17 trades, +4.4380% total return and 0.0118976% geometric daily growth at 12bp, PF 2.464 and MDD 1.234%, but had a negative median trade, 92.76% top-five positive-PnL concentration and -0.5817% after removing the top 10% of trades. The current first place remains unchanged; this result is provisional rank 3 by target proximity only.

Hard-valid official Binance USD-M one-minute flow-size and price-impact-efficiency study. Across 864 preregistered continuation, absorption, fragmentation and impact-transition policies, zero passed the development gate, so later stages remained unopened. The best raw four-trade fragmented-flow reversal produced +0.7523% total return and 0.0020533% geometric daily growth at 12bp, PF 2.128 and MDD 0.355%, but top-five positive-PnL share was 100% and top-10%-removed return was -0.0751%. Every candidate with at least 200 trades had negative after-cost geometric growth. It is provisional rank 6 by raw target proximity only and is not deployable.

Causal pooled Ridge UTC-state route selected XRPUSDT during UTC 08:00-15:59 with a 1.25 prior-only threshold. At 24bp the 2024-2025 selected-development path reached 5.0964x NAV and 0.223030% daily geometric growth across 58 trades, PF 4.8808, MDD 25.81% and median +2.1499%. Exact top-10%-all-trade winner removal before slot rerouting remained 3.6051x NAV and 0.175579% daily with all four half-years positive. The route is provisional because 720 filters were selected on the full 2024-2025 path, Binance/funding are proxies, exact Bybit execution is absent and official 2026H1 remains unopened.

A strategy frozen with information through 2023-12-31 opened 2024H1 as a sequential research interval. At 24bp the unchanged Donchian route produced +1.8461% total and 0.0100516% daily growth. One frozen pooled HGBT accept/flat filter improved the account to +7.3021% and 0.0387317% daily growth across 24 completed trades, PF 1.8712 and MDD 10.1656%, but median trade was -50bp, the five winners supplied all positive PnL, winner-removal rerouting returned -7.6610%, and MAE skill versus a constant baseline was negative. The exact information unit is retired and 2024H1 is now seen sequential evidence.
